title: Fixed-Copy Exponent Sets and Strict Singularity of Composition Operators Between Hardy Spaces
summary: For a bounded operator \(T\) between Banach spaces, we introduce the \emph{fixed-copy exponent sets} \[ \begin{aligned} \operatorname{Fix}_{\ell}(T) &:= \{r\ge1:T\text{ fixes a copy of }\ell^r\},\\ \operatorname{Fix}_{L}(T) &:= \{r\ge1:T\text{ fixes a copy of }L^r(0,1)\}. \end{aligned} \] For \(1\le p,q 0\) and \(1\le p<r\le2\), it constructs a single copy of \(L^r(0,1)\) in \(H^p\) on which lower \(L^s(E)\) estimates hold simultaneously for all \(1\le s\le p\), with constants depending on \(E\) only through \(m(E)\).
